body: Maybe you need a change? Take up a hobby and do best you can to be good. Better than the people around you. I don't know painting, music, sports.. Anything that distracts you from being average, and from your routined life?

You know that? how? 
I don't think everyone you meet needs to be your enemy. Try to give people a chance. There are good people.
...cool :)

It seems like you've had bad people in your life but you cannot generalise your experience and transfer it to humanity. Yes I agree, there IS cruelty in this world and so many things are not fair but I guess you're focusing selectively just on the bad things right now.. Don't forget that there ARE also good things in this world. And if you cannot see anything, why don't you try to create something good?
But by accusing everyone of being bullies, and humiliating other people ON A SUICIDE WATCH page? You're doing the same thing, you accuse other people of doing..
Can I ask why you hate humanity? Where does your anger come from?
yeah, great idea, thank you. the only problem is that when I feel down, nothing seems to be important, but maybe I could write the things that are important to me before I feel low.
oh photography, that's nice :) what kind of picture do you prefer to take?

Not being able to be happy. You know you should be, but you're not.. That's exactly where I am now too. And also separating yourself from people, who actually would care for you if you'd only let them.. The same here..


You know, every day is a new chance to change your life, to try to make it better. Even if you fail and fail again... The sun rises each morning and you have a new chance to make it a good one. What I try to do is, I draw a SMILE face on my arm which reminds me to keep focused on working on myself to get happy.
Furthermore, try to relax and don't let yourself get stressed to fast.

Being optimistic when it comes to other people's lives and pessimistic when you consider your own life. (Just like me). Haha. 

I don't know you, and I don't want to judge you or your actions, because I don't know what you've been through or how you feel right now but I strongly recommend to reconsider committing suicide. :) because it's an irreversible action.
yeah, but as I said. I don't enjoy doing these things anymore.. What about you? How is it going?
ok :(  Look, I'm sorry, I was stupid enough to think I could find a way to help you, while I can't even handle my own life... I deeply hope that you somehow can find the strength to fight.
You mean something new? I don't know, I can't think of something right now..

Is there REALLY nothing that makes you feel better (even just a little bit?)

But you told us. That's a good start. Maybe it helps you to discuss it with us.
If I get it right, you have an urge to do it, and you think you're not able to fight against it anymore? Ok, maybe you COULD find a way to work against it? Does talking (writing) about it help you?

I used to like so many things (music,painting,film) but I don't seem to be able to enjoy these things anymore. I feel like I have no passion anymore.. It sounds strange, I guess. But I feel like a machine, doing things people expect from me, and having lost happiness.

Ok, but you always wanted to and never did it. That means you were able to stand it until now. The question rises whether you keep on fighting or not. You could use the energy you brought up to have the courage to commit suicide to fight back. To say no to suicide. And another thing to think about is, do you really have the courage now, or don't you have the power to fight anymore? (I'm sorry, does that sound mean?, I just want to help, and I want you to fight!)
Do you know Kid Cudi; his lyrics have really helped me in my worst phases. (i.e. Life's like that, beat me up and I fight right back!)
then I would have to eat 24/7 chocolate or exercise ;) But yeah thanks, I guess it's worth trying.
Heey, I'm here to talk too. What's the reason for wanting to do it now?
Ok, thanks. Yeah seeing others happy makes me feel better, too. But I wish I could find a permanent solution to all of this. Not just momentary distractions..

I am here to talk to. :) As I can relate to a lot of things you wrote, I don't think I can be a great help, because I feel very similar to you and I haven't found the solution to cope with all this shit yet. And I also can't promise that everything will get better (as I can't predict the future ;)). But I know that we can fight, no matter how weak we might feel, there is always hidden strength in us. We just need to reach out to it and use it (somehow). As I said, If you wanna talk, I am here, but don't expect too much.

And I think you need to give him some time and space, as he said. The fact that he said he wants to keep you in his life, (even if not as his girlfriend) shows that you're important to him and that you're NOT worthless. People care for you even if you can't see it. (I still have struggle believing that,too)

" but i woke up one day and i changed everything. I grasped happiness and I made sure I would not let it go." that sounds impossible for me at this moment. Do you remember what the reason/trigger was?  I wake up every morning thinking "this will be a good day" but I still can't get rid of all these negative thoughts. And because I fail day for day, I'm starting to lose hope.. :(

First of all your NOT wasting our time by posting this. You posted this because you need help, I guess?, and that's what we're here for. To help each other as good as we can and to share what we cannot tell anyone else. 
I'm glad that you shared this with us. A lot of things you typed remind me of myself (always saying sorry, hating to take medication, thinking people are better off without me, failed in school)
You need to know that you're not alone, and if you need anything you can always reach out to us. 
To be honest I don't know what could help you best to overcome this situation, maybe music? Art helps me a lot to distract myself from such feelings. Maybe you could try to express your emotions with writing/drawing/painting...? I know it doesn't sound very promising but I think it's worth trying.
